string_values: Partial California36.5-41N winter-surface Davidson context within declared35-46N corridor. Exclude conditional VancouverIsland/JuanDeFuca extension,deeper California Undercurrent and full along-coast continuity. Positive poleward surface qualification is mandatory so a deep poleward maximum with opposed/missing/weak surface flow cannot stand in for Davidson. This is not independent water-mass/current-axis validation or proof of winter occurrence in every quarter.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

Partial31-34E southern Anatolian eastward limb of the Black Sea Rim system. Exclude closed whole-basin circuit,interior eastern/western gyres,coastal eddy loops,northern/Caucasus limbs and historical Southern/Caucasus alias mergers. Not a Gelendzhik2016-2017 mooring replication. Near-halt250-300m literature description has no numerical threshold or exact-zero claim and is not imposed as bottom.

temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December15,2022 00Z snapshots; not seasonal means, annual extrema or historical occupations.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native transverse columns. All32original cases and both owners in one cumulative query.
window_interpretation: Original owner0-200m core selection is not measured thickness, a tracing cap, instrument reach or seabed. Davidson northern-extension200m/depth-averaged cruise context and Rim qualitative250-300m near-halt/pycnocline/deployment context are not imposed boundaries.
surface_gate_interpretation: Original surface-rule application flag records which selector ran, not successful qualification or occurrence. A5cm/s surface selection does not require the primary10cm/s contour to reach0m; retain detached tops, no-selection and edge diagnoses.
layer_metric_interpretation: Thickness is lower minus upper, not absolute lower depth or core depth. Native span remains conditional component-model support, not a physical bound. Missing and censored remain unknown, not zero or current absence.
range_interpretation: Sampling-bracket scenarios are not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty or seasonal ranges.
identity_scope: Davidson partial California surface context is not deeper California Undercurrent or Vancouver/JuanDeFuca extension. Southern Anatolian Rim limb is not a whole basin circuit, northern mooring, basin gyre or coastal eddy. Exact original context retained; no parent depths inherited or bodies added.
interpretation: Partial fixed-axis component geometry is not independently flow-normal width, complete section or whole-route physical body. No joining cuts, independent water-mass/axis identification, terrain clearance or physical volume.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source attribution and qualifiers retained.
